content.thinking:
A discrepancy in seed 12 round 1: my implementation says "manifest is not valid JSON: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)" but the reference succeeded (rc=0)?! That means the reference accepted a manifest my implementation rejected.

Wait, the fuzzer writes the manifest to tmp/fz/manifest.json — but both fuzz runs (seed 11 and seed 12) run in parallel and share the same WORK directory! They overwrite each other's files. That's the bug in my test harness, not in the implementation.

Let me make WORK unique per seed.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='tmp/fuzz.py'
s=open(p).read()
old="""WORK = os.path.join(HERE, 'fz')
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)"""
new="""WORK = os.path.join(HERE, 'fz' + (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '0'))
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok')
EOF
cd /workspace && for s in 12 13; do (python3 tmp/fuzz.py $s 25 > tmp/out/fz$s.log 2>&1; echo "seed $s rc=$?" ) & done; wait; tail -3 tmp/out/fz12.log; tail -3 tmp/out/fz13.log
